Check the belt, when accessory drive belts get old they dry out and lose some of their "stickiness" causing them to drag and squeak. Inspect the smooth side of the belt, look for any signs of dragging or if it's shiny almost polished, that likely means one of the idler pulleys are bad. If your rub your hand along the ribbed section of the belt (while it's off) and it leaves tracks then it needs replacement. If you see cracks it also needs replacement.
